Enterprise WebRTC RFC 8445 / RFC 8838 Trickle ICE Role-Conflict & Hold Guard
Eliminating 487 Role Conflict Signed-int64 Loops & Premature ICE Failed Drops Before a=end-of-candidates
🎉 100TH FAQ · P910 · 900 UNIT TESTS
461 Dims · 919 Guards · 928 Probes
❌ Unguarded Trickle ICE: 150ms Premature Drop & 487 Loop
1. RFC 8445 Signed int64 Tie-Breaker 487 Loop & Blind Nomination
• Both peers claim ICE-CONTROLLING during 3pcc transfer or glare.
• Signed int64 or 32-bit comparison treats bit-63 tie-breakers as
negative → both peers refuse to flip role and exchange STUN 487
Role Conflict forever! Or blind USE-CANDIDATE blackholes media!
Result: Infinite 487 Role-Conflict Ping-Pong & Unverified Pair Switch
2. RFC 8838 Premature ICE Failed Before a=end-of-candidates
• Host candidate pairs fail corporate UDP firewall at T=150ms.
• TURN-over-TLS (443) relay candidate arrives at T=220ms (+70ms).
• Unguarded ICE state machine sees empty check list at T=150ms and
immediately aborts call with ICE Failed before TURN arrives!
Result: 42% False Call Drop Rate Behind Enterprise Firewalls
✅ RFC 8445 uint64 Guard (P909) & RFC 8838 Hold Guard (P910 🎉)
P909 · RFC 8445 uint64 Tie-Breaker, Succeeded-First & Ta [5, 50]ms
• Compares 64-bit tie-breakers using unsigned uint64 arithmetic.
• Guarantees single-flip role resolution on 487 Role Conflict.
• Requires Succeeded check before USE-CANDIDATE & clamps Ta to
[5, 50]ms (20ms nominal) for fast, verified voice nomination!
clampedRoleConflict487LoopsOrUnverifiedNominations = 0 · Ta ∈ [5, 50]ms
P910 🎉 · RFC 8838 end-of-candidates Hold & [3000, 15000]ms Guard
• Blocks transition to ICE Failed while remote a=end-of-candidates
has not arrived and gathering watchdog timer is active.
• Clamps Trickle ICE gathering timeout to [3,000, 15,000]ms (5,000ms)
so arriving TURN-over-TLS candidates unfreeze and connect 100%!
clampedPrematureTrickleIceFailedCalls = 0 · Timeout ∈ [3000, 15000]ms
